shared_elements: row of repeated short vertical strokes forming a band
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both include a band of repeated short vertical strokes (crew-strokes on the boat hull versus the ridged headdress/collar element) and both present their main subject in profile, with a wavy line present in each. Otherwise A depicts a manned boat with a beaked prow accompanied by a small quadruped and scattered strokes, while B depicts a large human head and torso in profile with elaborate headgear resting above a plinth — different subjects, relationships and conventions (flat silhouette painting versus modelled relief with anatomical detail).
